title: Defensive Stance Hold and React
description: Players hold a low defensive stance for time while reacting to a coach's hand signals for slide direction, building stance endurance.

content.objective: Hold a correct, low defensive stance under fatigue while still reacting quickly to signals.
content.setup: Players spread out facing the coach in a defensive stance.
instructions: Hold the defensive stance continuously while the coach points left, right, forward or back.
Slide one step in the signalled direction, then return to a neutral low stance.
Increase the pace of signals as the set progresses.
Finish with 10 seconds of fast feet in place without standing up.
coachingPoints: Keep the chest up even as the legs fatigue.
React immediately to each signal rather than anticipating the next one.
Keep the hands active and ready throughout.
commonMistakes: Standing up out of the stance as fatigue sets in.
Anticipating the signal instead of truly reacting.
Standing up tall instead of staying low through the movement.
content.safety: Make sure the floor is dry and clear of obstacles before sliding.
